scope_test.verdict: out of scope — no tenant-data path touched
rationale: No API route added or modified — this is a development-time Mix.Task, not mounted in any router or Plug pipeline.
No migration added or modified — no priv/repo/migrations/ file is touched.

No secret resolution — no System.get_env/1 call, no config/runtime.exs reference, no token/key materialised in any return value or struct field. System.cmd/3 shells out to `mix xref graph` (a built-in Mix command) purely to obtain compile-graph output, not to read credentials.
No response-shaping code for a tenant-scoped entity — the task writes only to IO.puts/Mix.raise, never to a Plug conn.
No lookup-by-ID handler — the task operates on file-path strings parsed from xref output, not on tenant data identifiers.

invariant_assessment.title: Tenant data isolation
invariant_assessment.reason: No Ecto schema, no migration, no business table, and no Repo call anywhere in the diff. Letflow.Modules.Catalog.all_manifests/0 returns code-level module manifests (id, depends_on), not tenant business data, and is not prefixed/scoped in the schema-per-tenant sense.

invariant_assessment.title: Server-side field authorisation
invariant_assessment.reason: No API response serialised. The task produces CLI output only (IO.puts / Mix.raise), never a Plug conn response or Jason-encoded payload.

invariant_assessment.title: Untrusted runtime sandboxing
invariant_assessment.reason: No Lua/WASM host function or capability surface added or changed.

invariant_assessment.title: Secrets by reference only
checks_run: Manual review of full file: no System.get_env/1, no hardcoded credential, no token literal, no field that could serialise a secret. System.cmd/3 passes only the string arguments ["xref", "graph", "--format", "plain"] to mix — no secret material in any argument.
invariant_assessment.reason: No secret is resolved, materialised, logged, or threaded through any value in the diff.

invariant_assessment.title: Not-found/forbidden indistinguishability
invariant_assessment.reason: No lookup-by-ID endpoint; no cross-tenant resource access pattern. The task resolves only local file-path strings.

invariant_assessment.title: New data-access paths prove their scoping
invariant_assessment.reason: This handoff is the required SECURITY-REVIEWER artefact. All applicable invariants (INV-4, INV-8) are explicitly assessed and found PASS; all others are NOT-APPLICABLE with recorded rationale. The meta-invariant is satisfied by the existence of this document.

invariant_assessment.title: No SQL string interpolation
invariant_assessment.reason: No Ecto query, no Repo call, no raw SQL of any kind in the diff.

invariant_assessment.title: No unhandled crashes on realistic failure paths
checks_run: Manual review: System.cmd/3 is matched as {output, _exit_code} — the standard two-tuple return; exit_code is intentionally discarded (task classifies violations from parsed output, not exit code). If mix is absent the ErlangError would crash the Mix task process, but Mix tasks run in a dedicated, isolated OTP process — a crash does not affect any production tenant workload. The let-it-crash exception in INV-8 applies: 'a doomed, isolated process crash and restart' is fine; this is dev/CI time only.
invariant_assessment.reason: No bare {:ok, x} = pattern on an external-I/O call. The one external call (System.cmd) is matched correctly. The task runs outside production supervision and cannot degrade tenant in-flight work.

invariant_assessment.title: Tenant-controlled outbound URL validation
invariant_assessment.reason: No outbound HTTP/HTTPS request to any URL, tenant-controlled or otherwise. System.cmd spawns a local subprocess, not an HTTP client.

result.summary: All 9 invariants assessed. INV-4, INV-6, INV-8 APPLY and each is PASS. INV-1, INV-2, INV-3, INV-5, INV-7, INV-9 are NOT-APPLICABLE. The diff introduces a development-time Mix.Task with no production data-path, no secret handling, no migration, and no API surface. No blocking issues found.
